name: B10-0233/2026 (PPE) – New Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the new Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
part_text:
**What this asks for**

The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion. It condemns a new Chinese law on "ethnic unity and progress," passed in March 2026, which it says will further suppress the languages, cultures and religions of ethnic minorities, especially Tibetans. It calls on China to repeal the law, release two named Tibetan detainees, and stop interfering in Tibetan Buddhist religious matters. It also urges the European Union to keep raising these cases with China.

**Key points**

- The Parliament asks China to scrap the new law and stop suppressing minority languages, cultures and identities.
- It calls for the release of Choktrul Dorjee Ten Rinpoche, Palden Yeshi and others held for peaceful expression.
- The European Union's diplomatic service, Commission and member states are urged to keep raising these cases with China.
